summary: Learn EDGE and LEED readiness through practical scorecards, credit matrices, and documentation workflows. Train your team for certification success.
lede: Green building certification readiness helps project teams assess baselines and organize evidence for EDGE and LEED submissions. For building owners, project managers, architects, engineers and sustainability consultants, the course covers credit mapping, energy, water and materials strategies, documentation coordination, and planning to close readiness gaps across design and delivery.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work around building projects and need to support green building certification, design coordination, or sustainability reporting. It is most useful when you are responsible for moving project information between consultants, contractors, and decision-makers and need a practical way to manage EDGE and LEED readiness.
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop and be ready to work with project templates, baseline sheets, and simple calculation exercises. Prior exposure to building project coordination, sustainability reporting, or design documentation is expected, and you should be comfortable reviewing tables, spreadsheets, and checklist-based evidence packs.
